ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle with R as the center. On the right side there is chord SU, and point V is on chord SU; the line segment starting from the center R passes through V, and a right angle is marked at V in the figure, indicating that this line through the center is perpendicular to chord SU. Reasoning: According to the circle theorem, a perpendicular drawn from the center of a circle to a chord bisects that chord. Therefore V is the midpoint of chord SU. Given SU = 20, so UV = SU / 2 = 10. The YW = 20 and arc YX = 45 given in the problem do not need to be used in this method.

The given YW=20 and arc YX=45 are not needed for this route.

推理：根据圆的定理，从圆心作到弦的垂线会平分这条弦。因此 V 是弦 SU 的中点。已知 SU = 20，所以 UV = SU / 2 = 10。题中给出的 YW = 20 和弧 YX = 45 在此方法中不需要使用。

method.method_draft: Read the image as forming triangle RSU inside the circle: S and U are points on the circle and R is the center, so RS and RU are radii. The line from R to V meets side SU at a right angle, as shown by the right-angle mark. Since RS=RU, triangle RSU is isosceles; in an isosceles triangle, the altitude from the vertex R to the base SU is also a median. Thus V is the midpoint of SU. With SU=20 from the text, UV=10. The YW and arc YX information is unnecessary here.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以 R 为圆心的圆，S 和 U 都在圆上，弦 SU 画在右侧。点 V 位于弦 SU 上，且从圆心 R 引出的线段 RV 与 SU 相交处标有直角符号，表示 RV 垂直于 SU。图中还画有 YW、YX 等部分，但它们不影响求 UV。

推理：因为 S 和 U 在圆 R 上，RS 和 RU 都是半径，所以 RS = RU。因此三角形 RSU 是等腰三角形，底边是 SU。又因为 RV 垂直于底边 SU，所以在等腰三角形中，从顶点 R 到底边 SU 的高也是中线。因此 V 是 SU 的中点。已知 SU = 20，所以 UV = 20 ÷ 2 = 10。
